body.statement: Does there exist a universal finite integer \(B\), independent of \(L\), \(\Delta\), compatible \(\zeta\), and \(v\in[0,1]\), such that both \(H_{\zeta}(v)\) and \(h_{\zeta}(v)\) are attained by a compatible hazard quadruple constant on at most \(B\) common subintervals? Establish the answer constructively: if affirmative, derive an explicit valid \(B\), prove equality with the finite optimization over \(\vartheta_B\), and characterize the optimizing incidence-survival tradeoff across normal, flat, singular, abnormal, and boundary regimes; if negative, construct a compatible family for which every exact optimizer has unbounded switching complexity. The mandatory early-kill instance is the positive-cell law \(\zeta_\star\) on the normalized unit bin at \(v=0\): within the \(z=w=1\) phase, analyze two complete repetitions of \((x,y)=(0,0),(1,0),(1,1),(0,1)\) under \(\Phi(\boldsymbol\theta)=0\). For the upper problem, \(\lambda_{\max}(\mathscr Q)>0\) is the constrained-Hessian sign for an improving local exchange, while an exact obstruction requires \(\mathscr Q\preceq0\) together with \(\max_{\overline{\mathcal T}_\star}\mathcal G_0>\max_{\partial\overline{\mathcal T}_\star}\mathcal G_0\); the lower problem uses the reversed signs.
body.justification: This is the theorem-level kernel: it decides whether the exact active-ceiling sharp frontier is a fixed-dimensional elementary program, and the specified two-cycle Hessian test can kill an invalid compression claim before mesh or inference work obscures the obstruction.
body.gap: Kim2023CompetingRisks supplies sequential nonlinear programs for a different discrete latent-duration model, while LasserreHenrionPrieurTrelat2008 supplies only convergent measure relaxations and ZhuTrelatCerf2016 shows that generic smooth control problems may chatter; none resolves endpoint-preserving finite compression for the hazard-spliced frontier.
body.consumer: A positive result makes exact ceiling-indexed grouped-data separable-effect bounds auditable for monthly competing-event analyses such as the SPRINT kidney-injury example in StensrudHernanTchetgenRobinsDidelezYoung2021; a certified two-cycle obstruction identifies the precise complexity barrier and forces a pivot rather than a gridded surrogate.
